palette_rationale: Preserve the approved 63-color Idle and its source-backed red eyes, dark rim, pupil, teeth, sail, and stripes. Do not add speculative projectile or facial pixels.
reference: Own DSTS chr389 model and its native clips; PMDO XML supplies action names and timing only.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Native forelimb and body cycle; endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Native forward leaping strike with open-mouth contact.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Native broad mouth opening/release; no projectile generated.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Native resting/crouched breathing; audition shows red eyes may stay visibly open and needs review.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Native backward recoil; avoid bd02/bd03 overturn for ordinary Hurt.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Native horizontal limb/body sweep; no weapon added.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two complete native leaping strikes; PMDO XML exposes one HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Native high leap/arc; distinct from ba01 strike.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Native outstretched anticipation and reverse sampled recovery; no effects invented.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Native gaze/face motion with explicit whole-view yaw; endpoint excluded.
